headline: Deffuant 2000 (agent-based): 2/3 locked clauses REPRO; major #clusters track floor(1/(2eps)); mu sets convergence time not #clusters

verdicts.gate: P1 (locked TOTAL #clusters) ~ floor(1/(2eps)) within +-1 for eps in {0.1,0.15,0.2,0.3}
reasons: eps=0.1: mean TOTAL #clusters=6.60 (pred ⌊1/(2eps)⌋=5, |diff|=1.60 > 1); eps=0.15: mean TOTAL #clusters=4.30 (pred ⌊1/(2eps)⌋=3, |diff|=1.30 > 1); eps=0.2: mean TOTAL #clusters=3.40 (pred ⌊1/(2eps)⌋=2, |diff|=1.40 > 1); eps=0.3: mean TOTAL #clusters=3.80 (pred ⌊1/(2eps)⌋=1, |diff|=2.80 > 1)

verdicts.gate: P3 TOTAL #clusters(mu=0.1)==#clusters(mu=0.5) at eps=0.2; mu sets speed only

extra.scope: faithful reproduction of a published synthetic model; no real-world data; the contribution is whether the harness + discipline reproduce the 1/(2eps) cluster law and the mu-is-speed result and would catch an artifact

citations: Deffuant, G., Neau, D., Amblard, F., Weisbuch, G. (2000). Mixing beliefs among interacting agents. Advances in Complex Systems 3:87-98.

benchmark.note: no cross-tool baseline; faithful single-implementation reproduction
